The starting code for Tab 3

Tab 3: Growth Plots, based on Existing Data (GAMLSS) 

--Domain drop-down 

--SCT drop-down, default to ALL 

--Pre-existing growth plots (static, except domain) 

--Figure caption, explain in Tab 5 

------Plot just 10, 25, 50, 75, 90 



```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(shiny)
library(gamlss)
library(gamlss.add)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)

new_gsv_long_rem <- readRDS("new_gsv_long_rem.rds")
```

Starting with the ui.r stuff
```{r}
selectInput("domain_select", "Select Domain:",
            choices = unique(na.omit(new_gsv_long_rem$domain)))

selectInput("sct_select", "Select SCT Condition:",
            choices = c("ALL", unique(na.omit(new_gsv_long_rem$sca_condition))),
            selected = "ALL")

```

```{r}
renderPlot({
  req(input$domain_select, input$sct_select)

  plot_data <- new_gsv_long_rem %>%
    filter(!is.na(domain), !is.na(sca_condition), !is.na(bsid_age_calc), !is.na(transformed_score)) %>%
    filter(domain == input$domain_select)

  if (input$sct_select != "ALL") {
    plot_data <- plot_data %>% filter(sca_condition == input$sct_select)
  }

  validate(
    need(nrow(plot_data) > 10, "Not enough data after filtering.")
  )

  model <- gamlss(
    formula = transformed_score ~ pb(bsid_age_calc, lambda = 5),
    sigma.formula = ~pb(bsid_age_calc),
    nu.formula = ~1,
    tau.formula = ~1,
    data = plot_data,
    family = BCCG()
  )

  age_seq <- seq(min(plot_data$bsid_age_calc, na.rm = TRUE),
                 max(plot_data$bsid_age_calc, na.rm = TRUE),
                 length.out = 100)

  qvals <- centiles.pred(model, xname = "bsid_age_calc", xvalues = age_seq,
                         cent = c(10, 25, 50, 75, 90), plot = FALSE)

  pred_long <- pivot_longer(as.data.frame(qvals), -x,
                            names_to = "Percentile", values_to = "Score")

  ggplot(pred_long, aes(x = x, y = Score, color = Percentile)) +
    geom_line(size = 1.2) +
    geom_ribbon(
      data = data.frame(
        x = qvals$x,
        ymin = qvals$`10`,
        ymax = qvals$`90`
      ),
      aes(x = x, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      alpha = 0.2,
      fill = "gray70"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Growth Chart for", input$domain_select),
      x = "Age (months)",
      y = "Transformed Bayley Score",
      color = "Percentile"
    )
})


```
